notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1d
notes.content: [h1]Hotfix 1.0.1d[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that unlocked multiple achievements when starting a new game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that forced the player's sprint when starting a new game[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1c
notes.content: [h1]Hotfix 1.0.1c[/h1][list][*][p]Implemented several performance improvements especially when other characters appear[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the emergency lights and the [b]#Anomaly03[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated several plants and water decorative elements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1b
notes.content: [h1]Hotfix 1.0.1b[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed several issues in [b]#Anomaly04[/b],[b] #Anomaly29 [/b]and[b] #Anomaly38[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the new game loading menu that caused interface problems[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with several suitcases in different hallways[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when starting a new game that generated the last anomaly you had seen in the previous game[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content: [h1]Update 1.0.1[/h1][p][/p][h2][u]Minor fixes[/u][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in [b]#Anomaly34[/b] when playing [b]#BlackoutMode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a mouse issue in the escape menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in [b]#Anomaly05[/b] when playing [b]#MadnessMode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented [b]#MadnessMode[/b] from being playable even after escaping in the other game modes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented matches from starting correctly when clicking the [b]#NewGame[/b] button while playing [b]#MadnessMode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the name of an achievement in Spanish[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][u]Major fixes and additions[/u][/h2][list][*][p]Added a more detailed explanation of how the game mechanics work during the loading screen, which also lets you view the different hallways[/p][/*][*][p]Added game instructions to the escape menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the options system for better performance, especially resolution settings[/p][/*][/list]
